body:
## Recent Activity

Synced window: `2026-05-07T12:05:17Z` to `2026-05-08T12:05:17Z`. Signals include 2 issues, 5 PRs, 2 discussions, and 0 commits.

Main activity focused on generated-comment cleanup and automation trust gates. [PR #162](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/162) was merged for `fix-pr` status comment cleanup. [PR #163](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/163) remained open after merge-conflict fixes and follow-up discussion about why inline review comment cleanup needs a time cutoff. [PR #166](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/166) opened from [issue #165](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/165) to add an opt-in `agent-self-approve` gate and went through several review/fix-pr passes.

## Recently Active PRs

- [#162](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/162) “Collapse old fix-pr status comments” was merged on 2026-05-07 after routing unsupported `fix-pr` status posting through the shared cleanup path.
- [#163](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/163) “Collapse older generated inline review comments” is open. It resolved conflicts after #162 merged, then had user/agent discussion about the timestamp gate used to preserve current-run inline comments.
- [#166](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/166) “Add opt-in agent self-approval gate” is open. Reviews/fix-pr passes addressed merge conflicts, route validation, trusted review provenance, stale-head safeguards, and self-approval status comment hardening.
- [#117](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/117) “Report failed agent runs to Discussions” is closed in the synced signals; prior discussion favored a safer diagnosis/approval-gated reporting direction.
- [#120](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/120) “Add GitHub App installation bootstrap” is open and present in signals, but no notable new comment activity is visible in the synced artifact.

## Recently Active Issues

- [#165](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/165) “Implement requested change” is open and produced [PR #166](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/166) for the opt-in self-approval gate.
- [#68](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/68) “For the fix-pr, new fix-pr should collapse previous fix-pr comments?” was closed after [PR #162](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/162) merged.

## Recently Active Discussions

- [#153](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/discussions/153) “Add a yolo mode for sepo” led to the conservative `agent-self-approve` design and an `/implement` request that created [issue #165](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/165).
- [#164](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/discussions/164) “Daily Summary — 2026-05-07” received project-management summary comments, including labels for [issue #165](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/165) and [PR #166](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/166).

## Follow-ups

- Review next action for open [PR #166](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/166), since it is the active high-impact self-approval gate work.
- Decide whether [PR #163](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/163) is ready after the conflict fixes and timestamp-gate clarification.
- Keep [PR #117](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/117) closed/held unless the newer approval-gated diagnosis direction is intentionally revived.
